plan.title: Control-plane consolidation (bounded contexts, contracts, single-owner guards)
plan.goal: One owner per decision, enforced by a Rust contract guard and the existing system-state-authorities registry; C1-C5 as checks on a supported install; adopt-vs-build on explicit criteria with sunsets (rev 5)
success_criteria: Each declared decision maps to one owner in the five contexts (K1-K5) and nine aggregates (A1-A9); overlap and orphan counts are computed by a tool, MVP-scope rows 0/0 at S12
A new non-owner mutation of an owned decision, or a cross-context call outside a versioned contract, fails tier0 and the trusted required CI check, with negative tests a candidate cannot weaken
The supported install meets C1-C5 (no required hosted API, Node-free build and runtime closure, pinned, 16 GB offline-capable, licence-cleared); unresolved C3/C5 is not PASS
No component is replaced without retiring the old one; every spike has a sunset
